purpose: Local sample provenance and rights notes; not an inference approval.

upstream.paper_citation: Choi, S.; Park, S.; Lee, M.; Choo, J. VITON-HD: High-Resolution Virtual Try-On via Misalignment-Aware Normalization. CVPR 2021.
upstream.dataset_description: Official README describes a 1024x768 research dataset of frontal-view woman and top-clothing pairs.
upstream.conditions: Non-commercial purposes only; cite the paper and indicate changes.

retrieved_from.license_conflict: The Hugging Face mirror claims the broader CC BY 4.0, while the original VITON-HD upstream states CC BY-NC 4.0. This review relies only on the original, narrower non-commercial terms; no broader mirror grant is assumed.
retrieved_from.provenance_limit: The selected mirror files were not byte-compared with the original authors' linked Google Drive archive.

rights_review.noncommercial_scope: Private technical research only; no commercial use or public image/output publication.
rights_review.visual_age_observation: The selected catalog-model image appears adult; this is visual observation only, not verified age.
rights_review.remaining_uncertainty: The upstream dataset license permits non-commercial reuse to the extent the licensor controls the relevant rights. It does not by itself establish all subject, photographer, catalog, privacy, or likeness permissions.
rights_review.approval_scope: User approved this exact pair for private non-commercial Azure research: two requests total, one per selected model, no retries; this is not a blanket rights grant.

pair.evaluation_limit: No exact target-wearing ground truth exists for this cross-pair. Assess output visually against the two inputs only; do not report a ground-truth similarity score.

person.appearance: Modern color catalog-model portrait, front-facing with a slight body angle, head to hip visible, one hand visible; wears a plain black long-sleeve top distinct from the target.

garment.appearance: Isolated white and navy horizontal-striped top with yellow neckline and sleeve-cuff trim; stripe spacing and direction, neckline, sleeves, and hem are visible.

other_reviewed_candidate.license: CC BY 4.0 as declared by the card
other_reviewed_candidate.limitation: Synthetic person and garment; the person already wears the target garment, so the pair tests only trivial same-garment reconstruction. Not a replacement for the VITON-HD real catalog-model photo.

excluded_candidate.reason: Official upstream requires a signed release agreement, disallows release to private companies, and requires institutional email. Do not access until those conditions are met.
